title: FeatureSpec
description: Typed spec consumed by scaffold-feature.mjs. All required fields must be present before the script runs.

huId.description: Identifier of the User Story (HU) that originated this feature — e.g. HU-17

entitySingular.description: PascalCase entity name — e.g. Zone, BillableConcept

featureName.description: kebab-case, used as folder name and route path — e.g. zones, billable-concepts

moduleSrcPath.description: Relative path from src/app/modules/ to feature parent — e.g. master-data/configuration

pagesKey.description: Key in PAGES constant (layout-pages.ts) — e.g. ZONES. If new, script prints the entry to add.

entitiesKey.description: Key in ENTITIES constant (entity-name.model.ts) — e.g. ZONES. If new, script prints the entry to add.

backendBaseUrl.description: Full base URL using environment variable — e.g. ${environment.apiGw.myservice.url}/zone (replace 'myservice' with your project's actual apiGw config key)

softDelete.description: true = dar de baja (deletionDate), false = hard delete

activeEntityRouting.description: true when the entity can be inactive and routes must guard against it. Defaults to softDelete value.

entityStatus.description: Field names for active/inactive status. Required when softDelete=true.

extras.description: Additional permission codes beyond the 5 base

fields.description: All entity fields except id (id is always generated). FK fields must include fkEntity.

name.description: camelCase field name — e.g. externalCode, supply

type.description: TS type: string | number | boolean | Date — or FK type name (e.g. SupplySearch, Periodicity)

required.description: true = non-nullable in Entity; required validator in FormBuilder

inSearch.description: true = include in EntitySearch type and in table COLUMNS constant

labelEs.description: Spanish label — used in es.json and form.labels

labelEn.description: English label — used in en.json and form.labels

fkEntity.description: FK type name — must match type when type is non-primitive. e.g. SupplySearch

selector.description: Selector component tag for FK field — e.g. app-supply-selector

i18nKey.description: Override i18n key for form.labels — defaults to field.name if omitted

formSplit.description: simple = zones canonical | split = companies canonical | split+workflow = pucs canonical

filterFieldName.description: Service.filterFieldName override. Defaults to first required string field.

translocoScope.description: Transloco scope name — used in provideTranslocoScope. e.g. zones, supplyBillingYears

i18nPath.description: Path under public/i18n/modules/ WITHOUT feature folder — e.g. master-data/configuration

parentRoutesFile.description: Relative path from project root to the parent routes file that must register this feature — e.g. src/app/modules/master-data/configuration/configuration.routes.ts

menuGroup.description: Identifier of the menu group in menu.service.ts where PAGES.{pagesKey} must be added — e.g. configuration, periodicBilling

tabs.description: Form tabs for CONTENT_INDEX and i18n. Defaults to a single basicData tab if omitted.

label.description: camelCase tab key — e.g. basicData, parameters

key.description: camelCase section key — e.g. generalInfo, fiscalAddress

icon.description: FontAwesome class string — e.g. fa-duotone fa-regular fa-circle-info text-primary

formArrays.description: Staging tables / editable sub-entities in the form

statuses.description: All possible status values — e.g. [DRAFT, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED]

action.description: Action name — e.g. approve, reject, submit

layout.description: standard = script generates L6+L7 structure | custom = script skips L6+L7, LLM generates from scratch

hasExport.description: true = list uses p-splitButton with export option (LE-0028)
